newsitem.title: LEBANON: Lebanese pound gains against dollar.
newsitem.headline: Lebanese pound gains against dollar.

text.p: The Lebanese pound countinued its rise against the dollar in the week ended on Thursday in very calm trading, dealers said.
The pound closed nearly two points up on the week in interbank trade at 1,542.25-1,542.5 to the dollar from 1,544-1,545 last Friday.

"This recovery of the pound is a trend that started last week and continued this week in very calm market trading," Treasurer and Forex Manager for Banque Libanaise pour le Commerce Nabil Abou Jaoude told Reuters.
The Bank of Lebanon lowered its bid-offer intervention band during the week to 1,539.5-1,548 pounds per dollar from 1,540-1,548.5.
All demand for the U.S. currency was met by commercial banks, Abou Jaoude added.
Banks and financial markets will close on Friday and Monday for the Good Friday Eastern and Eastern Easter holidays.
